text: Shahi Masjid (Chiniot) Phone: (+92) 51-9252516 Email: info@doam.gov.pk Login Home About Us ( Heritage of Pakistan Publications Projects Advertisements Resources Complaints Trainings Contact Us Shahi Masjid (Chiniot) Type: Monument - Mosque Province: Punjab District: Chiniot Period: Historic Relative Chronology: 1526 - 1857 CE Description: It is a three domed structure with an ablution tank in the center of the courtyard. It is a brick structure with a sprinkling of black streaked stone. The stones are used in the steps of the eastern and northern entrances and for the bases of the pilasters in the outer walls of western side. The size of the brick used is generally 20.3 x 8.8 x 2.5 cm. The interior of the prayer chamber on close examination reveals that it was originally decorated with floral and geometrical patterns in different colours.
